profile.summary: Shree Digvijay Cement Company Limited, together with its subsidiary, engages in the manufacture and sale of cement in India. It offers ordinary Portland cement, Portland Pozzolana cement, sulphate resistance Portland cement, oil well cement, and PPC, OPC, SRPC cements under the KAMAL CEMENT and CEMENT KA SARDAR brands.
